links.outcome: Clinician-reported trust formation with uncertainty visualization in an AI mental health screening model
links.effect: Clinicians reported that violin-plot visualization of confidence and uncertainty supported trust and aligned with their expectations of decision ambiguity. Qualitative only, with no numeric effect.
links.quote: Trust formation was supported by the explainability of the model, particularly through (1) visualization of confidence and uncertainty through violin plots, aligning with the clinicians' expectations of decision ambiguity; (2) feature attribution for and against predictions, which mirrored clinical reasoning; and (3) use of pseudo-sumscores in the AI model, which increased interpretability by presenting explanations in familiar clinical formats.

unlisted_practices: Presenting AI explanations in familiar clinical formats (pseudo-sumscores) to build clinician trust
Limiting AI use to low-risk pre-interview screening with suicide risk flagging as a safety protocol

screen.reason: Qualitative case study investigating how clinicians form trust in an AI mental health screening tool piloted in a clinical setting.
